verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair axis for a SaaS work-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export feature, open export formats, or an account-exit path. The GraphQL API and integrations are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented export-all capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
